basic_details.job_title: Lok Nayak Hospital Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in for 32 Posts

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: The age of the applicant should not exceed 30 years as on 01.10.2026.

qualification.details: Internship Condition: Only those candidates are eligible who have completed their internship after 15 October 2024 and before the date of 15 October 2026. Candidates who furnish internship completion certificate prior to 15 October 2024 shall be treated as ineligible.

vacancy_details.details: Total vacancies available for the post of Junior Resident are 32.

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay Matrix Level-10, Basic Pay Rs. 56,100/-
salary_details.junior resident: Pay Matrix Level-10 as per 7th CPC, Basic Pay Rs. 56,100/- and other admissible allowances per month.
salary_details.details: The pay includes basic pay and other admissible allowances per month as per government rules.

selection_process: The selection process consists of an interview only and selection will be made strictly on merit basis.
how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application format from the official notification.
Fill in all required details in block letters.
Attach self-attested photocopies of date of birth certificate, educational qualification, DMC registration certificate, internship certificate, and caste/category certificate (if applicable).
Ensure application reaches the E-I, Branch, 1st Level MRD Block, Lok Nayak Hospital, New Delhi-110002.
Submit the application by hand or post on or before 15 October 2026 till 02:00 PM.
Bring original certificates for verification at the time of joining or interview.
important_instructions: The appointment shall be initially on adhoc basis for a period of 44 days and extension shall be given on the basis of satisfactory work and conduct report. Private practice of any kind is not allowed. Junior Residents are entitled to 2½ days leave for one complete calendar month. The contract may be terminated by either side with 10 days notice or salary in lieu thereof. Selected candidates who accept the offer of appointment and join the hospital will not be given NOC of any kind for any purpose whatsoever. No TA/DA shall be paid to those who are appearing in the interview. Selected candidates shall be allowed to join immediately failing which the offer of appointment shall stand automatically cancelled.

faq.question: Q1. What is Lok Nayak Hospital Junior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by Lok Nayak Hospital, New Delhi, to fill 32 Junior Resident posts on an adhoc basis for 44 days.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 32 vacancies available for the Junior Resident post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 15 October 2026 till 02:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date of the interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 22 October 2026 at 10:00 AM (Reporting Time) in Room No. 139, OPD First Floor, Lok Nayak Hospital, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from a recognized University/Institute or equivalent degree along with a valid DMC registration.
